thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SR-2026-03-15-77 - sudden drop in average quality for /v1/generate. Trigger: quality_score_drop > 0.2 and cheap-variant selection spike. Investigate.

oncall-bot: Paging @sara (oncall) and @matt (secondary) :bell:

sara: ack. jumping in. pulling the policy change history and routing logs now.

matt: past hour looks normal until ~1769165938. Then policy weights show cost bias changed. Pasting snippet:
```
[1769165938] route_eval route=/v1/generate policy_weights={quality:0.05,latency:0.05,cost:0.90} selected=quant-slim-01
[1769165939] runtime_quality=0.20
```

eva-ml: I queried config-store. The promotion pipeline accidentally applied `COST_BIAS=HIGH` for this route in prod. Commit b2a8f4 promoted at 1769165925. That commit was meant for a staging benchmark.

matt: git show b2a8f4 reveals comment "temp cost bias for perf run" and the pipeline used promo-token without manual gate.

support-luke: support rolling in ~11 tickets flagged "worse outputs", customers include Ledgerly and BriefAI. Tickets show hallucinations and persona/context loss. Estimated affected session rate ~6% for those customers.

ops-jen: recommend immediate actions:
- force-pin /v1/generate -> hq-stable
- disable cost-based routing for this route
- quarantine quant-slim-01

sara: applying mitigations now.

sara: ```bash
# emergency pin
redwoodctl route set-variant --route "/v1/generate" --variant hq-stable --reason "SR-2026-03-15-77 emergency revert"
# disable cost routing
redwoodctl policy update --route "/v1/generate" --set weights.quality=1.0 --set weights.cost=0.0
# quarantine variant
redwoodctl variant quarantine --name quant-slim-01 --percent 0
```

deploy-bot: policy update and pin deployed (change_id=chg-20260315-77-1). Quarantine applied across zones.

matt: monitoring metrics: cheap-variant selection dropped from 64% -> 1.2% within 4 minutes. quality_score recovering 0.52 -> 0.84 (10m post-change).

support-luke: sending initial customer notices to affected accounts; will include apology and short technical summary.

kai: +1 on mitigation. Post-incident, we should prevent promotions that set cost_weight > 0.5 without explicit approval. Also add a runtime circuit-breaker: if cheap_variant_pct > 20% and avg_quality < 0.7 -> auto-pin to HQ for 10m.

eva-ml: ML follow-ups: add regression test that promotes cost-heavy policy and measures eval delta against production prompt set. Also add cheap-variant into nightly diff queue.

matt: infra follow-ups: the promo script allowed env overrides. I'll add a guard to reject COST_BIAS env in prod pipelines and default to safe weights. Opening PR now.

ops-jen: ops will run a 2h watch window and keep quant-slim-01 quarantined to 0% traffic. We'll also throttle any auto-rollbacks for 24h.

product-tim: product will coordinate customer comms and review impacted sessions for potential credits. We'll prepare a public status note if customers ask.

sara: severity lowered to SEV3. Handoff: I'm oncall for 15 more minutes; kai will take lead on postmortem and follow-ups. Assign owners now:
- CI guard + promo MFA: matt/ci-team
- runtime circuit-breaker & alerts: kai/runtime
- ML regression tests: eva-ml/zara
- customer comms: product-tim/support-luke

kai: taking postmortem lead. I'll open ENG-INC-2026-03-15-77 and populate timeline + owners. Quick timeline I'll add to ticket:
- 1769165925: commit b2a8f4 promoted to prod (cost bias)
- 1769165938: policy applied, cheap-variant selection spikes
- 1769165950: monitoring/alerts tripped
- 1769165990: mitigations (pin + quarantine) applied
- 1769166300: metrics stabilized

support-luke: customers acknowledged the note; a couple requested logs and an offer for a follow-up call. product-tim will coordinate.

matt: note: adding an alert for large policy_weight delta (abs(delta.cost) > 0.2 in 1m) to page SRE. Also adding unit test in promo pipeline to prevent env override of COST_BIAS in prod unless `--manual-approve` used.

eva-ml: I'll add the regression harness and link it to the postmortem. We should also surface quality delta per-variant in the console so product/support can triage faster.

kai: creating action list and due dates in the incident ticket. Plan to run a tabletop next week to walk through promo pipeline mistakes.

sara: closing active page. I'll stay reachable for 30m. Please add any remaining notes to ENG-INC-2026-03-15-77 and tag me.
